title: Fernando Mendoza: Starting is a "new step," but it's not a whirlwind

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza: Starting is a "new step," but it's not a whirlwind
sources.description: Everyone knew that it was only a matter of time before Fernando Mendoza became the Raiders' starting quarterback, but the first overall pick in this year's draft said on Wednesday that he was taken by surprise when he learned the time had come.
